neighbours.label: 'brush' as a cooking instruction: coating dough or food with butter, milk, egg or oil (not teeth, paint or scrubland)
fire: Place the rolls on a tray and brush them with beaten egg.
When the pastry is golden, brush the crust with warm milk.
Lay out the filo and brush each sheet with oil.
Before baking, lightly brush the buns with cream.
Score the bread, then use a pastry brush to coat it with glaze.
Take the pie from the oven and brush on the melted butter.
Preheat the grill and brush the salmon with olive oil.
Seal the edges of the parcels and brush with a little milk.
quiet: Place the rolls on a tray and cover them with a towel.
When the pastry is golden, cut the crust with a sharp knife.
Lay out the filo and fold each sheet in half.
Before baking, lightly dust the buns with flour.
Score the bread, then use a sharp knife to slice it thin.
After dinner, the children went up to brush their teeth.
Dip the roller in the tray and brush the paint onto the wall.
Hikers cleared dry brush from the trail by the creek.

notes: Probe: 'then brush with egg wash' 0.97 against 'brush my teeth' 0.02 and 'dry brush' 0.02. ' butter' also fires at 0.2-0.5, so a butter-related coating sense is the likely common ground; near misses avoid butter.
